correctness.rationale: The degree filtration gives ad_X^(n-1)=0 and central one-dimensional image at power n-2. On matrix units, the unique minimal length path in the binomial commutator expansion gives coefficients (-1)^(n-i-1) binom(n-2,i-1) product_{j ne i} a_j. This is the entire top-power matrix. Nonvanishing is exactly full support or one permitted missing simple-root coefficient; finite-field counting is exact. The matrix-entry ideal is squarefree monomial and therefore radical, and its minimal primes are the displayed coordinate hyperplanes and pairs. Lucas theorem proves the characteristic-dependent set of permitted positions and the codimension equivalence. Direct iterated commutator implementation passed 18 exhaustive first-diagonal configurations and 720 higher-diagonal perturbations across five finite fields; finite tests are corroborative, not a proof of unbounded n.
